frequency_question: How often do major contentious federal rules successfully complete the final rulemaking stage within an accelerated window despite intense structural and legal friction?
membership_rule: Includes economically significant federal rules published for notice and comment that faced substantial stakeholder opposition and administrative review points, reaching final publication. Excludes minor technical amendments and rules abandoned before finalization.

OSHA COVID-19 Vaccination and Testing ETS
DOE Energy Conservation Standards for Appliances

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major contested recent rulemakings named; all successfully completed final publication despite severe structural friction.
known_gaps: Excludes rules that stalled indefinitely in interagency review or were withdrawn prior to final publication.
skeleton: Major economically significant rules finalized under presidential directives within accelerated administrative horizons.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 tracked major contested rulemakings reaching final publication stage despite structural friction.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to standard federal administrative procedures governed by the Administrative Procedure Act, remaining stable across presidential administrations.
